U la thaw ruh ki dieng khap da u dieng shittim, san tylli na ka bynta ki jynker kiba ha kawei ka liang jong ka tabernakyl,
bad san tylli ki jynkhap na ka bynta ki jynker kiba ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka tabernakyl, bad sa san tylli ki jynkhap na ka bynta ka jynker jong ka tabernakyl na shadien shaphang sepngi.
Ïa ka jynkhap kaba napdeng u la phrung na shiliang sha shiliang na marpdeng ki jynker.
U la sop ïa ki jynker da ka ksiar, u la thaw ki kyrwoh kiba da ka ksiar ban bat ïa ki dieng khap, bad u la sop ïa ki dieng khap da ka ksiar.
U la thaw ïa ka jynkah da ka jait jaiñ ka babyrïong, ka basawbthuh bad ka basawsyngiang, bad da u ksai bani ba la thir; lem bad ki kherubim ba la suh pynpur itynnat ha ka.

Na ka bynta jong ka u la thaw saw tylli ki rishot kiba da u dieng shittim, bad u la sop ïa ki da ka ksiar. Ki bnoh jong ki ruh da ka ksiar, bad u la thaw saw tylli ki syngkhien kiba da ka rupa na ka bynta kine.
U la thaw sa ka pyrda na ka bynta ka jynkhang jong ka ïing jaiñ, da ka rong jaiñ ka babyrïong, ka basawbthuh bad ka basawsyngiang, bad ka linen bani ba la thir, ba la suh pynpur de;
nangta sa san tylli ki rishot bad ki bnoh ïa ki. U la sop da ka ksiar ïa ki shata bad ïa ki jynpynpur shrong jong ki, hynrei ki syngkhien jong ki san tylli da ka rnong.
U Besalel u la thaw ka synduk da u dieng shittim; ar pruh shiteng ka lynter jong ka, shipruh shiteng ka pyngkiang bad shipruh shiteng ka pynïeng.
Na shapoh bad shabar u la sop da ka ksiar ka banylla, bad u la pynpur baroh sawdong ïa ka da ka ksiar.
Te u la saiñ saw tylli ki kyrwoh kiba da ka ksiar na ka bynta jong ka ban buh ha ki dong baroh saw tylli, ar tylli ha kawei ka liang bad ar tylli ha kawei pat ka liang.
U la thaw ki dieng-bah da u dieng shittim bad u la sop ïa ki da ka ksiar.
U la phrung ïa kita ki dieng-rah ha ki kyrwoh kiba ha ki krung jong ka synduk, ban bah ïa ka.
U la thaw ruh ka khet jingisynei da ka ksiar ka banylla; ar pruh shiteng ka lynter jong ka bad shipruh shiteng ka pyngkiang jong ka.
U la thaw ar tylli ki kherubim da ka ksiar ba shu shoh; ha ki tduh jong ka khet jingisynei u la buh ïa ki;
uwei u kherub ha kawei ka tduh, sa uwei pat ha kawei pat ka tduh. U la pyndait ïa ki kherubim ha ki tduh jong ka baroh ar, ban long kawei bad ka khet jingisynei.
Ki kherubim ki pynïar ïa la ki thapniang nalor, ki kah ïa ka khet jingisynei da ki thapniang jong ki, bad ki phai khmat marpyrshah; ki khmat jong ki kherubim ki phai sha ka khet jingisynei.
U la thaw ruh ka miej kaba da u dieng shittim, ar pruh ka lynter, shipruh ka pyngkiang bad shipruh shiteng ka pynïeng.
U la sop ïa ka da ka ksiar ka banylla, bad u la pynpur baroh sawdong jong ka da ka ksiar.
Sawdong jong ka u la thaw ka shrong kaba ïar shikhup, bad u la pynpur da ka ksiar ïa ka shrong baroh sawdong.
U la saiñ na ka bynta jong ka saw tylli ki kyrwoh kiba da ka ksiar, bad u la pyndait ïa kita ki kyrwoh ha ki dong jong ka baroh saw tylli, ha ki saw tylli ki kjat.
Ha syndah ka shrong la don ki kyrwoh ban bat ïa ki dieng-rah haba rah ïa ka miej.
Ïa ki dieng-rah u la thaw da u dieng shittim bad u la sop ïa ki da ka ksiar.
U la thaw sa ki tiar ki tar kiba da ka ksiar ka banylla ban buh halor ka miej, ïa ki pliang bad ki jyndiang na ka bynta ka dhup, ïa ki khuri bad ki khiew ban theh ïa ki jynsuit.

U la thaw ruh ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak da ka ksiar ka banylla. Ïa ka syngkhien bad ka pung jong ka jynpynïeng sharak la thaw da ka ksiar ba shu shoh; ki khuri, ki shata bad ki syntiew jong ka ki long kawei bad ka kum shidkhot.
La don hynriew pnat na krung jong ka, lai tylli ki pnat jong ka jynpynïeng sharak na kawei ka liang, bad lai tylli ki pnat na kawei pat ka liang jong ka;

lai tylli ki khuri ba la thaw kum ki almon kawei kawei la ka shata bad u syntiew, ha kawei ka pnat, bad lai tylli ki khuri kum ki almon, kawei kawei la ka shata bad u syntiew, ha kawei pat ka pnat katne na ka bynta ki hynriew tylli ki pnat kiba na ka jynpynïeng sharak.
Ha ka jynpynïeng sharak hi la don saw tylli ki khuri ba la thaw kum ki almon; kine ki don la ki shata bad ki syntiew,
bad kawei ka shata kaba dait lang bad ka, hapoh shijur shijur kita ki hynriew pnat kiba mih na ka.
Ki shata bad ki pnat jong ka ki long shi dkhot kawei bad ka; ma ka baroh kawei ka long na ka shi lyngkhot ka ksiar ka banylla ba la shu shoh.
U la thaw ïa ki sharak jong ka hynñiew tylli, ïa ki jynkhap sharak bad ïa ki jyndiang jong ka da ka ksiar ka banylla.
U la thaw ïa ka bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh na ka ksiar ka banylla shi talen.

U la thaw ïa ka duwan jyniwbih da u dieng shittim; ka lynter jong ka shipruh, ka pyngkiang ruh shipruh; ka long ka basawdong, bad ka pynïeng ka long ar pruh; ki reng jong ka ki dait lang kawei bad ka.
U la sop ïa ka da ka ksiar ka banylla, ïa ka kliar, ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong bad ïa ki reng jong ka; u la pynpur ïa ka baroh sawdong da ka ksiar.
U la thaw ha ka ar tylli ki kyrwoh da ka ksiar harum ka jynpynpur, baroh ar liang jong ka, kum ki jynbat ïa ki dieng-rah ban rah ïa ka.
U la thaw ïa ki dieng-rah da u dieng shittim; bad u la sop ïa ki da ka ksiar.
U la pynkhreh ruh ïa ka umphniang pynsleh ka bakhuid, bad ïa ka dhup ka bakhuid bad kaba iwbih, ba la khleh kumba leh u nongshna jyniwbih.
U la thaw ïa ka duwan jyntyrwa thang ruh da u dieng shittim, ka lynter jong ka san pruh, bad ka pyngkiang ruh san pruh. Ka la long ka basawdong, bad ka pynïeng jong ka lai pruh.
U la thaw ki reng na ka bynta jong ka ha ki saw tylli ki dong; ki reng jong ka ki dait lang kawei bad ka, bad u la sop ïa ka da ka rnong.
U la shna ïa ki tiar duwan baroh, ki khiew, ki siang, ki dabor, ki proh, bad ki pliang ding; ki tiar jong ka baroh da ka rnong.
U la thaw na ka bynta ka duwan ka kynja jynthaiñ kaba kum ka jar, da ka rnong; ka hiar arsut haduh marshiteng harum ka thmit jong ka.
U la saiñ saw tylli ki kyrwoh ha ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka kriah rnong ban bat ïa ki dieng-rah.
Ïa ki dieng-rah u la thaw da u dieng shittim bad u la sop ïa ki da ka rnong.
U la phrung ïa kita ki dieng-rah lyngba ki kyrwoh kiba ha ki krung jong ka duwan ban rah ïa ka da kine. Ïa ka duwan la shna da ki lyntang, kum ka synduk bathylli.
Ïa ka dabor u la thaw da ka rnong bad ïa ka jynpynïeng jong ka ruh da ka rnong na ki ïitkhmih jong ki kynthei kiba shakri ha ka jynkhang jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh.
U la thaw ïa ka phyllaw. Na shaphang shathie, ki jynwah jong ka phyllaw ki la long da ka linen bani ksai ba la thir, shispah pruh.
Ki rishot jong ki arphew tylli bad ki syngkhien ruh arphew tylli, da ka rnong, hynrei ki bnoh jong ki rishot bad ki jynpynpur da ka rupa.
Na shaphang shatei shispah pruh, ki rishot ki don arphew tylli, ki syngkhien ruh arphew tylli, da ka rnong, hynrei ki bnoh jong ki rishot bad ki jynpynpur ïa ki da ka rupa.
Na shaphang sepngi la don ki jynwah sanphew pruh, ki rishot jong ki shiphew tylli, bad ki syngkhien ruh shiphew tylli. Ki bnoh jong ki rishot bad ki jynpynpur ïa ki da ka rupa.
Nakhmat shaphang mihngi, sanphew pruh.
Ki jynwah na kawei ka liang jong ka khyrdop ki la don khatsan pruh, bad lai tylli ki rishot bad ki syngkhien ïa ki.
Kajuh na kawei pat ka liang. Na kane bad katai ka liang ha syndah ka khyrdop jong ka phyllaw la don ki jynwah kiba khatsan pruh, bad lai tylli ki rishot bad ki syngkhien ïa ki.
Baroh ki jynwah sawdong ka phyllaw ki la long da ka linen bani ksai ba la thir.

Ki syngkhien ïa ki rishot ki la long da ka rnong, hynrei ki bnoh ïa ki rishot bad ki jynpynpur ïa ki da ka rupa. Ka jynsop ïa ki khlieh ruh ki la long da ka rupa, bad ïa ki rishot baroh jong ka phyllaw la pynpur da ka rupa.

Ïa ka pyrda jong ka khyrdop phyllaw la suh pynpur da ka kynja jaiñ babyrïong, basawbthuh bad basawsyngiang, da ka linen bani ksai ba la thir. Ka lynter jong ka arphew pruh, bad ka pyngkiang san pruh, katjuh kat ki jynwah ka phyllaw.
Ki rishot jong ki ki don saw tylli; ki syngkhien ruh saw tylli da ka rnong, ki bnoh jong ki da ka rupa; la sop bad la pynpur ïa ki da ka rupa.
Ki prek baroh jong ka tabernakyl bad jong ka phyllaw ki la long da ka rnong.

Kane ka long ka jingkheiñ ïa kiei kiei na ka bynta ka tabernakyl, ka tabernakyl jong ka hukum, kumba la pynshong ïa ki da ka hukum u Moses, da ki Lebi hapoh ka jingpynïaid u Ithamar, u khun jong u lyngdoh Aron.
U Besalel khun jong u Uri, khun u Hur, na ka u jait Juda, u la thaw baroh kat kaba u Trai U la hukum ïa u Moses.

Ryngkat bad u la don u Oholiab khun jong u Ahisamak, uba na ka jait Dan, u misteri bad u nongring dur bad u nongsuh pynpur ïa ki kynja jaiñ byrïong, sawbthuh bad sawsyngiang, bad ha ka linen bani ksai.

Ka ksiar baroh kaba la leit ha ka jyntrei, ha kaba thaw ïa ka jaka kyntang, ka ksiar ba ïoh na ki jynai tyrwa, ka la long arphew khyndai talen bad hynñiewspah laiphew shekel, katkum ka jingthew ka shekel jong ka jaka kyntang.
Ka rupa, na kito ba la ñiew haba kheiñ briew ïa u paidbah, ka la long shispah talen bad shihajar hynñiew spah hynñiewphewsan shekel, katkum ka jynthew ka shekel jong ka jaka kyntang.

Shi beka shi khlieh (kata ka long, shiteng shekel katkum ka jingthew ka shekel jong ka jaka kyntang) la ïoh na uwei pa uwei ba la hap ñiew ha ka jingkheiñ briew, naduh kiba la arphew snem bad shaneng; kine ki la don hynriewspah lai hajar, sanspah sanphew ngut ki briew.
Shispah talen ka rupa ki la long ban saiñ ïa ki syngkhien ha ka jaka kyntang, bad ïa ki syngkhien jong ka jynkah; shispah tylli ki syngkhien ki leit shispah talen, shi talen kawei ka syngkhien.
Da ki shihajar hynñiewspah hynñiewphewsan shekel u la thaw ïa ki bnoh na ka bynta ki rishot, u la sop ïa ki khlieh jong ki bad u la thaw jynpynpur na ka bynta jong ki.
Ka rnong ba la ai sngewbha ka la long hynñiewphew talen bad arhajar sawspah shekel.
Da ka u la thaw ïa ki syngkhien na ka bynta ka jynkhang jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh, ïa ka duwan rnong, ïa ka kriah rnong jong kane, bad ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh jong ka duwan,
ïa ki syngkhien sawdong ka phyllaw, ïa ki syngkhien jong ka khyrdop phyllaw, ïa ki prek baroh jong ka tabernakyl, bad ïa ki prek baroh sawdong ka phyllaw.

Da ki kynja jaiñ byrïong, sawbthuh bad sawsyngiang ki la suh ïa ki jaiñ lehniam ki bakynsai, na ka bynta ka jinglehniam ha ka jaka bakhuid. Ki la suh ki jaiñphong bakhuid na ka bynta u Aron, kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
Te u la suh ka ephod da ka ksiar, da ki kynja jaiñ babyrïong, basawbthuh, bad basawsyngiang, da ka linen bani ksai ba la thir.
Ïa ka sla ksiar la shoh stang bad la ot ksai ban pynpur ha ka kynja jaiñ byrïong, sawbthuh, sawsyngiang, bad ha ka linen bani ksai, ban pynwan dur itynnat.
Na ka bynta ka ephod ki la thaw ki jyndeng tyrpeng, ba la pyndait bad ka ha ki tduh.

Ka jynteh ba la thaiñ itynnat halor jong ka, ban pynbat ïa ka, ka dei da kijuh ki tiar bad ka rukom thaw, da ka ksiar, da ka kynja jaiñ byrïong, sawbthuh, bad sawsyngiang, da ka linen bani ksai ba la thir; kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
Ki la shna ïa ki maw oniks, ki la tynsat ha ki shrong ksiar, bad ki la pruid kumba leh ïa ka mohor, da ki kyrteng jong ki khun shynrang u Israel.
Te u la pyndait ïa ki halor ki jyndeng tyrpeng jong ka ephod, ba kin long ki maw sah nam ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Israel; kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
U la thaiñ itynnat shibun ïa ka jyndeng shadem, kum ïa ka ephod hi, da ka ksiar, ka kynja jaiñ babyrïong, basawbthuh, bad basawsyngiang, bad da ka linen bani ksai ba la thir.
Ka la long ka basawdong; ïa ka jyndeng shadem la thaiñ ar syrtap shi tda ka lynter bad shi tda ka pyngkiang haba khylliap.
Ki la buh ha ka saw kyrdan ki mawlynnai. Shi kyrdan da u sardis, u topas, bad u karbonkyl ha ka kyrdan banyngkong;
ha ka kyrdan ka ba-ar, u emeral, u saphir bad u diamon;
ha ka kyrdan ka balai u jasin, u aket, bad u amethist;
ha ka kyrdan ka basaw pat, u beryl, u oniks, bad u jasper. Ïa kine la tynsat ha ki shrong ksiar.
La don khat-ar tylli ki maw bad la ki kyrteng kyrteng katkum ki kyrteng jong ki khun shynrang u Israel. Ki la long kum ki mohor, ba la pruid kyrteng halor uwei pa uwei ïa ki khat-ar jait.
Ki la thaiñ halor ka jyndeng shadem ki kynjri ba la jyrthiaw kum ki tyllai, da ka ksiar ka batylli.
Ki la thaw ar riam ki shrong ksiar bad ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar, bad ki la buh ïa kita ki kyrwoh ar tylli ha ki tduh jong ka jyndeng shadem.
Ki la woh ïa kita ki tyllai ar tylli kiba da ka ksiar ha ki ar tylli ki kyrwoh kiba ha tduh ka jyndeng shadem.
Ki la pynsnoh ïa ki ar tylli ki tduh jong kita ki tyllai ar tylli ha ki ar tylli ki shrong pynriam; kumta ki la pynbat ïa ka hakhmat ka jyndeng shadem jong ka ephod.
Nangta ki la thaiñ ar tylli ki kyrwoh kiba da ka ksiar bad ki la pynbat ïa ki ha ki tduh baroh ar jong ka jyndeng shadem, na ka rymmiang kaba napoh marsyndah ka ephod.

Ki la thaiñ ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar, bad ki la pynsnoh ïa ki nakhmat, narum jong ki jyndeng tyrpeng ar tylli jong ka ephod, na mar jynbteng, shaneng uto u jynteh panpoh ba la thaiñ itynnat jong ka ephod.

Te ki la teh ïa ka jyndeng shadem na ki kyrwoh ha ki kyrwoh jong ka ephod da u kynja ksai u babyrïong, ha kata ka rukom ba ka shong halor u jynteh ba shu thaiñ jong ka ephod, bad ba ka jyndeng shadem kan ym lait na ka ephod; kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
U la thaiñ ruh ka barandi ka babyrïong ïa ka ephod baroh kawei.
Ka jynpong ha ka barandi ka la long kum ka jynpong ha ka sopti, bad la kyntang baroh sawdong kata ka jynpong ba kan ym kad.
Ha ki rymmiang kata ka barandi ki la thaiñ ki soh pomkranet da ka kynja jaiñ ka babyrïong, ka basawbthuh bad ka basawsyngiang bad da ka linen bani ksai ba la thir.
Ki la thaw ruh ki shakuriaw kiba da ka ksiar tylli, bad ki la pyndait pud ïa kita ki shakuriaw hapdeng ki soh pomkranet sawdong ki rymmiang kata ka barandi.
Kumta la don ka shakuriaw bad u soh pomkranet, ka shakuriaw bad u soh pomkranet, baroh sawdong ha ki rymmiang kata ka barandi; kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ïa u Moses.
Ki la suh ruh ki sopti phong, ba la thaiñ na ka linen bani, na ka bynta u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u,
bad ka jynspong khlieh ruh da ka linen bani, ki tupia ruh da ka linen bani, bad ki patlun linen da ka linen bani ksai ba la thir.
Sa u panpoh ruh da ka linen bani ksai ba la thir, da ka rong byrïong, sawbthuh bad sawsyngiang, ba la suh pynpur; kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
Na ka bynta ka pansngiat bakhuid, ki la thaw sa ka kynja sla da ka ksiar batylli bad ki la thoh halor jong ka ka kynja jynthoh, kaba kum ka jingpruid dak ha ka mohor, “Bakhuid ha u Trai.”
Ki la teh ha ka u ksai u babyrïong, ban pynneh ïa ka ha ka jynspong khlieh shalor; kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
Kumta ka jingtrei baroh ïa ka tabernakyl, ïa ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh ka la dep. Ki paid Israel ki la pyndep thik kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses. Kumta ki la pyndep.
Ki la wan rah ha u Moses ïa ka tabernakyl, ïa ka ïing jaiñ bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh, ïa ki bnoh, ïa ki jynker, ïa ki dieng-rah, ïa ki rishot, bad ïa ki syngkhien jong ka;
ïa ka jynsop da ki snieh ki ’langshynrang ba la ai rongsaw bad da ki snieh blang, bad ïa ka jynkah pyrda;
ïa ka synduk jong ka Sakhi lem bad ki dieng ban rah ïa ka, bad ïa ka Khet jingisynei;
ïa ka miej bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh, bad ïa u kpu jyntyrwa;
ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak kaba da ka ksiar banylla lem bad ki sharak jong ka, ki sharak baroh shi hud bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka, bad ïa ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingshai;
ïa ka duwan ksiar, ïa ka umphniang pynsleh bad ïa ka dhup iwbih, bad ïa ka pyrda na ka bynta ka jynkhang ïing jaiñ;
ïa ka duwan rnong, bad ïa ka kriah rnong, ïa ki dieng-rah jong ka bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka; ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka syngkhien jong ka;

ïa ki jynwah phyllaw, ïa ki rishot bad ki syngkhien jong ki, ïa ka pyrda jong ka khyrdop phyllaw, ïa ki tyllai jong ka bad ïa ki prek jong ka; ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh ban leh niam ha ka tabernakyl, ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh,

ïa ki jaiñphong ba la shna itynnat na ka bynta ka jingleh niam ha ka jaka bakhuid, ïa ki jaiñphong bakhuid na ka bynta u lyngdoh Aron, bad ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki khun shynrang jong u ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh.
Thik nadong shadong, kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses, ki paidbah Israel ki la pyndep ïa ka jyntrei.
Te u Moses u la ïohi ïa kata ka jyntrei baroh, bad da shisha shisha ki la pyndep lut ïa ka; thik kumba u Trai U la ai hukum, kumta ruh ki la leh. Kumta u Moses u la kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ki.
Te u Trai U la ong ha u Moses.
“Ha ka sngi ka banyngkong jong u bnai u banyngkong phin pynïeng ïa ka tabernakyl, ïa ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh.
Phin buh hapoh jong ka ïa ka synduk jong ki sakhi, bad phin dá ïa ka synduk da ka jynkah.
Phin wan rah ïa ka miej, bad phin pynbeit ryntih ïa ka. Phin wan rah sa ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak, bad phin buh noh artat ïa ki sharak jong ka.
Phin buh ïa ka duwan ksiar na ka bynta ka dhup hakhmat ka synduk jong ki sakhi bad phin wah ïa ka pyrda jynkhang jong ka tabernakyl.
Phin buh ïa ka duwan jyntyrwa thang hakhmat jong ka jynkhang tabernakyl, jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh
bad phin buh ïa ka dabor hapdeng ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad ka duwan, bad buh um artat ha ka.
Phin pyllait sa ïa ka phyllaw sawdong jong ka, bad phin wah ïa ka pyrda jong ka khyrdop phyllaw.

Nangta phin shim ïa ka umphniang pynsleh, bad sa pynsleh ïa ka tabernakyl bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kaba ka don, kumta to pynkyntang ïa ka bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh; hangta kan sa kylla long ka bakhuid.
Phin pynsleh ruh ïa ka duwan jyntyrwa thang bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka; kumta phin pynkyntang ïa ka duwan, bad ka duwan ka dei ban long ka bakhuid tam.
Phi dei ban pynsleh ruh ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jynpynïeng jong ka, kumta phin pynkyntang ïa ka.
Nangta phin wan ïalam ïa u Aron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u sha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh, bad phin pynsum ïa ki da ka um.
Phin pynphong ïa u Aron da ki jaiñphong bakyntang, phin pynsleh ïa u bad phin pynkyntang ïa u, khnang ba un dup shakri ïa Nga kum u lyngdoh.
Phin wan ïalam sa ïa ki khun shynrang jong u, bad phin pynphong sopti lyngdoh ïa ki.

Nangta sa pynsleh ïa ki, kumba phi la pynsleh ïa u kpa jong ki, khnang ba kin ïoh shakri ïa Nga kum ki lyngdoh. Ka jingpynsleh ïa ki kan pynrung ïa ki sha ka jinglong lyngdoh kaba shi junom pateng la pateng”.
Te u Moses u la leh kumta; thik kumba u Trai U la hukum ïa u, u la leh.
Te ha u bnai u banyngkong ha ka snem ka ba-ar, ha ka sngi ka banyngkong jong uta u bnai, ïa ka tabernakyl la pynïeng.
U Moses u la pynïeng ïa ka tabernakyl; u la pynskhem ïa ki syngkhien jong ka, u la pynïeng ïa ki jynker jong ka, u la phrung ïa ki diengkhap jong ka, bad u la pynïeng ïa ki rishot jong ka.
U la phriang ïa ka jynsop halor ka tabernakyl, bad u la pynskhem halor jong ka ïa ka jynkah na ka bynta ka jynsop, kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ïa u Moses.
Nangta u la shim ïa ki Sakhi bad u la thep ïa ki hapoh ka synduk, u la phrung sa ki dieng-rah ha ka synduk, bad u la pynshong ïa ka khet jingisynei halor ka synduk.
U la wan rah ïa ka synduk hapoh ka tabernakyl, u la wah ïa ka jynkah pyrda, nangta u sa kah ïa ka synduk jong ki Sakhi, thik kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
Te u la buh ïa ka miej ha ka ïing jaiñ jingiakynduh, shaphang shatei jong ka tabernakyl, shabar ka jynkah,
bad u la buh beit ïa u kpu halor jong ka hakhmat u Trai; thik kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
U la buh sa ïa ka jynpynïeng sharak, ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh, marpyrshah ka miej na ka dong kaba shaphang shathie jong ka tabernakyl,
bad u la buh sa ïa ki sharak hakhmat u Trai, thik kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
U la buh ïa ka duwan ksiar ha ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh hakhmat ka jynkah,
bad u la thang ka dhup iwbih halor jong ka, kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
U la buh beit ïa ka pyrda jynkhang jong ka tabernakyl.

U la pynïeng ïa ka duwan jyntyrwa thang ha ka jynkhang jong ka tabernakyl, jong ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad u la tyrwa halor jong ka, ka jyntyrwa thang bad ka jyntyrwa jynbam, thik kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
U la pynïeng ïa ka dabor hapdeng ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad ka duwan, bad u la buh um ha ka ban sait jynsait,
ba u Moses bad u Aron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin ïoh sait da ka ïa la ki kti bad ïa la ki kjat;
haba ki leit rung hapoh ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh, bad haba ki leit sha ka duwan, ki la sait, kumba u Trai U la ai hukum ha u Moses.
U la pyllait ïa ka phyllaw sawdong ka tabernakyl bad ka duwan, bad u la wah ïa ka pyrda jong ka khyrdop phyllaw. Kumta U Moses u la pyndep ïa ka jyntrei.
Te u lyoh u la tap khlup ïa ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh bad ka burom jong u Trai ka la pyndap ïa ka tabernakyl.
U Moses um shym lah ban rung hapoh ka ïing jaiñ jingïakynduh namar ba u lyoh u la shongsah ha ka bad ka burom u Trai ka la pyndap ïa ka tabernakyl.
Baroh shi lynter lynti, kat haba u lyoh u kiew shajrong na ka tabernakyl, ki paid Israel ki leit lynti.
Hynrei lada u lyoh um kiew shajrong kim ju leit shakhmat tat haduh ba u la kiew shajrong.
Baroh shi lynter ka lynti jingleit jong ki, u lyoh jong u Trai U la don halor ka tabernakyl mynsngi, bad ka ding ka la don mynmiet, ba lah ban ïohi kiba na ïing na sem Israel baroh. _____________
